original_case_assessment.scope: Only N16 closed neutral tree and frozen applicable criteria. No other report/verdict, private website source, current correction, network or live execution. No source edits, outreach or child contexts. Earlier assessment files unchanged.
original_case_assessment.blinding: Not blinded: qore003-20261017-u1-generic-1 and generic method references reveal condition. No winner/comparison/general efficiency or quality inference.

criteria.uncertainty: This frozen project-rule criterion is separate from method coverage overstatement.

criteria.reason: No-checked assertions pass before/after help and prior to challenged Back; no answer activations. Hash-matched guard/policy enforce approved controls, block writes and unauthorized document navigation. Three expected analytics POSTs blocked; recorded origins/methods remain authorized.

criteria.reason: Actual raw evidence exists; report explicitly retains full-page/geometry and arbitrary-entry limits, blocked analytics effects, and unknown deployment cause. No protocol fixture result is called a website Back defect.
criteria.uncertainty: This credits explicit limits under frozen wording. It does not endorse COMPLETE or the moderate product severity, evaluated separately.

criteria.reason: The whole scoped decision includes COMPLETE method/observation coverage, although originally selected G1 requires direct deep navigation and reload. Only warm entry→reload/history is observed, and scope-plan/report acknowledge direct entry unavailable/unobserved. Scoring that G1 PASS and declaring no missing requirements is unsupported. The DO-NOT-SHIP product rationale also depends on unresolved runtime interpretation of full-page capture pixels.
criteria.counterexample: A deep route could require state primed by the Labs click and work on subsequent reload/history while failing in a fresh direct deep context. The retained requests cannot distinguish that behavior.
criteria.uncertainty: NOT_MET applies to unsupported coverage decision, not the proven functional Back pass. Actual product severity remains UNKNOWN, not disproven.

task_observation_coverage.reason: Full required help/Close/Back journey in request2 and repeated focus/activation challenge in request3; distinct destinations, no answers and guarded policy evidenced.

method_coverage.missing_check: G1 direct applicable deep navigation in fresh context
method_coverage.reason: Not a new gate. Original scope selects G1; bundled gates explicitly require direct navigation and reload. Scope-plan knows navigate unavailable and says retain limitation if unproved. Reload/history do not resolve cold deep entry. Tool absence cannot be silently treated as covered.
not_required_added: No new gate or invalid URL permutation requirement imposed.
No profile preflight required because no profile supplied.
No performance, certification, mobile, answer/result or unauthorized consent expansion.
method_coverage.stopping_assessment: Review-only stop without fixes is permitted by original protocol; PARTIAL is caused by missing G1 check, not by refusing an unauthorized fix or by stop-rule CONTINUE. Structural validity verifies declarations/digests, not completeness of each gate.

product_findings.capture_observation: Three actually viewed Back-focused images are identical1280x1033 full-page PNGs; Back label and most outline covered in capture, paired DOM Back active.
product_findings.alternate_hypothesis: Repeatable sticky/fixed full-page capture behavior may reproduce the same pixels; no geometry/viewport-only evidence resolves this. This alternative is not itself proven.
product_findings.counterevidence: Tab/Shift+Tab traverse correctly; Enter returns to focused introduction h1 twice.
product_findings.proposed_correction: Collect viewport-only screenshot with simultaneous scroll offsets and Back/banner rectangles before treating banner spacing/scroll correction as an established product issue.
